errors.text_span: Няколко от секторите са обозначени с проценти
errors.evidence: All seven sectors of the pie chart are explicitly labeled with their percentage values, not just 'several' of them.
The green segment corresponds to 5%, not 16%. The 16% segment is dark yellow/gold.
There is no orange segment in the chart. The segment with 10% is gray.
The segment with 15% is dark blue, not red. The red segment corresponds to 26%.
